text: Seven stages. Evidence at every step.
An engagement starts with a clear question, preserves the evidence behind each finding, and returns to the same measurement after a change.

This is the intended service workflow. This website presents the planned method and sample reporting. Public intake is not open yet. Engine monitoring, automated audits and email delivery are not connected. Sample figures demonstrate a format; they are not results.
Begin with the company domain and the question the audit should answer. Separate a request for measurement from the completed measurement itself.
An intake record and a clearly stated scope.
Confirm the brand, category, competitors and questions before collecting evidence. Record which engines and collection conditions will be used.
An agreed scope and draft prompt panel.
Lock the panel and preserve a baseline
Keep a versioned copy of the prompts and record collection dates, sources and methodology. A later change to the panel starts a new comparison period.
A baseline with traceable evidence, when a real collection has been completed.
Review technical access, content quotability, off-site authority and measured visibility separately. Leave missing dimensions unmeasured; do not manufacture a composite.
Findings with sources, limitations and a proposed fix path.
Review the recommendations and decide which changes belong in scope. Record the decision and the reason before work proceeds.
An approved set of changes, or a documented decision to hold.
Prepare content and technical artifacts for review. Check each draft against the approved scope and its underlying evidence. Publication is a separate action.
After an approved change is implemented, collect a comparable reading against the preserved panel. Treat delays, failed collections and missing evidence explicitly.
A new evidence record and a comparison only where the method and provenance match.
Stages 01–04 establish the initial evidence. Stages 05–07 form a review and measurement loop. Re-baseline explicitly when the agreed scope or methodology changes.

text: A measurement practice, not an agency.
MindLeverX is a practice in development. The method starts with evidence: label sample figures, preserve the source of a measured reading and state clearly when a capability is not connected.
What MindLeverX is, in one paragraph

is a generative engine optimization practice for mid-market B2B SaaS. Its intended workflow measures whether AI answer engines cite a brand, preserves the evidence, and prepares content and technical changes for review. This website introduces the intended method and sample reports. Audit requests and engine collection are not available yet.

There is no team page because there is no team yet. That is a deliberate disclosure rather than an omission: a practice that sells measurement should not begin by asking you to take an unmeasured claim about itself on trust.

The work is narrow on purpose. One category — mid-market B2B SaaS. One methodology, versioned. One question: when a buyer asks an answer engine who solves this problem, does your brand appear in the answer, and can you prove the change when it does?
What that buys you is the thing agencies at scale struggle to offer — a straight line from the person taking the measurement to the person explaining it.
across the four proposed methodology dimensions, when evidence is available.
against a fixed, versioned panel; API collection is a future integration.
with recommendations and evidence ready for review.

No promised rankings, citation rates or share of voice. The intended process preserves evidence and methodology versions.
The intended workflow prepares content artifacts as drafts for your approval. No CMS credentials change hands.
Readings of different provenance are never averaged or trended together.
Four areas of evidence, with explicit gaps.

The proposed Methodology V1.0 identifies four review areas. A composite formula, weights and validation are unresolved; no scoring rubric is implemented in this preview. The version number matters more than the score: a rubric that changes silently makes every trend meaningless.
The full definition of GEO is here →
Whether answer engines can reach, render and parse the pages at all — crawler policy, server rendering, structured data, heading structure.
Whether a passage stands alone well enough to be lifted into an answer with no surrounding context — answer-first definitions, dated and sourced claims.
Whether the wider web treats the brand as the entity that belongs in the answer — corroboration across the sources engines actually read.
Whether the brand actually appears, run against a fixed prompt panel locked at baseline, so a later reading can be compared with an earlier one.
A number without a label is a claim.
Every figure MindLeverX publishes carries a label describing how it was obtained:
. The label travels with the number wherever it appears — in a scorecard, a report, an alert or on this site.
The rule that follows from it is the one the whole product rests on:
figures of different provenance are never compared.
A measured reading and an inferred one do not average into a meaningful score, and a trend built from both describes nothing.

Our intended reporting method identifies the product, questions and collection conditions behind each observation. Model-API results are distinct from observations of consumer ChatGPT and other consumer interfaces; they cannot establish what a customer sees in those products.

text: The playbook for getting your brand cited, quoted and recommended by the AI answer engines your buyers now ask first — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude.

is the practice of engineering a brand's content, technical setup and off-site presence so that generative answer engines — like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude — cite, quote and recommend it inside their answers. Where SEO competes for a ranked link, GEO competes to
FIG. 01 · SAMPLE — NOT MEASURED. ILLUSTRATIVE VALUES PENDING MONITORING API.
Search changed. Optimization had to follow.

For twenty years, winning search meant ranking a link that a human then clicked. Generative engines broke that contract: they read the sources, synthesize an answer, and hand the buyer a conclusion — often citing only a
That shifts the goal. The unit of visibility is no longer a blue-link position; it's whether the model
when it composes the answer. GEO is the discipline of earning that — layered on top of the SEO fundamentals that still make your content credible and crawlable.
The unit of visibility is no longer a blue-link position — it's whether the model names you and quotes you.

It is not a trick or a prompt. It's the same authoritative, well-structured content that ranks — engineered further so a machine can lift a clean, self-contained, attributable answer straight from your page.
GEO vs. SEO — same foundations, different finish line.
GEO doesn't replace SEO; it extends it. The technical hygiene and quality signals overlap, but what you're optimizing
— and how you measure it — changes.
Rank a link on the results page
Be cited and quoted inside the answer
A model synthesizing a few sources
Third-party citations — G2, Reddit, Wikipedia, roundups
TABLE 01 · GEO VS SEO — MINDLEVERX METHODOLOGY V1.0
These studies address different questions. Their methods and scope matter when interpreting the findings.
The GEO paper tested content changes on 1,000 queries using GPT-3.5 and five retrieved sources. Results varied by tactic and domain; they are not a customer-lift forecast.

Google visits with vs. without an AI summary; summary-source links received clicks on 1% of visits with a summary. 900 U.S. adults, 68,879 searches in March 2025; results reconstructed in April. Observational, not a universal or causal estimate.
These are proposed review areas, not a validated ranking of effects across answer engines.
A claim the model can lift whole — stated plainly, near the top, without needing the surrounding page for context.
Server-rendered HTML, clean headings, and schema so a crawler parses the meaning, not just the pixels.
Check dates, sources and support for each material claim; do not assume that adding a citation guarantees selection.
Review relevant third-party references and whether they support the claims made about the brand.
Use evidence about customer questions to propose a panel; treat untested ideas about demand and citations as hypotheses.
Is GEO just SEO with a new name?

No. GEO shares SEO's technical foundations — crawlability, structure, quality — but optimizes for a different outcome: being cited inside a generated answer rather than ranking a link a human clicks. The overlap is real, which is why GEO layers on top of SEO instead of replacing it.

The generative answer engines your buyers use — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google's Gemini / AI Overviews, and Claude — plus the AI features now embedded in classic search. Because each synthesizes answers differently, GEO monitors visibility across all of them rather than optimizing for one.
How do you measure GEO if there are no rankings?
With answer-engine monitoring: citation rate (how often your pages are cited), mention rate (how often your brand is named), and share of voice (your citation share versus the category). The
illustrates a possible reporting format. Daily engine collection and a validated scoring rubric are not connected in this build.
How long until GEO shows results?

There is no delivery or outcome guarantee in this preview. A meaningful comparison requires actual collection dates, a fixed prompt panel and enough evidence to separate a change from ordinary engine variation.
What does a GEO engagement actually involve?
The intended workflow agrees scope, preserves a baseline, reviews findings, records approval and prepares changes before measuring again. The
